description: A bounty hunter, armed with a hatchet instead of a gun, is hired by a crippled mayor to recover a kidnapped woman. Along the way he uncovers a plot to loot silver mines and settles an old score.

description: Two con artists (James Mason, Gina Lollobrigida) bring an outlaw (Lee Van Cleef) into their scheme to bilk the Mexican government out of $1 million.

description: Mexican bandit brothers (Gian Maria Volonte, Klaus Kinski) lure a U.S. mercenary (Lou Castel) to join their revolution, complicated by an assassination plot.

description: The efforts of a crooked rancher to monopolize water rights are stymied by a young widow and a hired killer.

title: West of Hell
description: A gunslinger, a vengeful ex-slave and a runaway discover their train is haunted by a sinister force.

description: In one of the first horror films in Welsh, a farmer unearths an ancient stone head that triggers the murderous wrath of sacred Celtic gods.

title: Moon Child
description: A white European orphan (Enrique Saldana) believes himself to be an African tribe's predestined ruler.

title: VR Fighter
description: After his wife's death, professional bodyguard Long Wei goes overseas to find doctors for his daughter, but instead he finds a new job as a virtual reality tester.

title: Don't Open the Door
description: A young woman (Susan Bracken) visiting her grandmother realizes there is a killer in the house.

title: The White Reindeer
description: A shaman turns a newlywed woman into a vampiric white reindeer after she seeks his help.

title: Leptirica
description: A group of rural villagers is beset upon by the infamous vampire Sava Savanovic, who has taken up residence in the local flour mill.

title: I Bury the Living
description: The chairman (Richard Boone) of a cemetery thinks a person dies when he moves their pin on a plot chart.

title: The Last Island
description: Five men and two women, marooned survivors of an air crash, discover that they may be the only survivors of a world disaster.

title: The Killing Floor
description: The story of a slaughterhouse worker (Damien Leake) and union trouble culminates in the Chicago race riot of 1919.

title: The Final Countdown
description: A time warp takes the aircraft carrier USS Nimitz and its captain (Kirk Douglas) back to Pearl Harbor, Dec. 6, 1941.

title: The Case Is Closed: Forget It
description: An architect ends up in prison for manslaughter and discovers the harsh reality behind bars, made up of rules, protections and criminal organizations.

title: Shin Ultraman
description: After the accidental death of a human during battle, Ultraman takes on the man's appearance and place at the S-Class Species Suppression Protocol to protect Earth from further threats.
